title: Extraction Protocol for Plant Material
author: Ricardo M. Borges
materials: Esquema para amostra de Controle de Qualidade Externo

steps.title: Grind material and weigh 10 g
steps.instruction: Grind the entire dried plant material with a coffee grinder until a homogeneous powder is obtained, then weigh 10 g and place it into a 50 mL Falcon tube; store the remaining ground material in separate Falcon tubes.

steps.title: First extraction: add, vortex, sonicate
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL of the extraction solution to the 10 g of plant material, mix with a vortex mixer, then sonicate for 5 minutes in an ultrasonic bath.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 4000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect first supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 mL of the supernatant to a new, labeled 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Second extraction: add, vortex, sonicate
steps.instruction: Add another 25 mL of extraction solution to the plant residue, vortex for 30 seconds, and sonicate for an additional 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 4000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect second supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 mL of the supernatant to the same labeled 50 mL Falcon tube used for the first extract, then vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Dry extracts in SpeedVac
steps.instruction: Transfer the combined supernatants into 13 mL carbonized glass tubes and dry them using a SpeedVac concentrator.

steps.title: Transfer dried extract to Eppendorf
steps.instruction: Move the dried extract from the carbonized glass tubes into Eppendorf tubes and record the weight of each tube for reference.

steps.title: Collect analytical aliquot
steps.instruction: Pipette 500 µL of the dried extract into a clean, labeled vial for analytical data acquisition (LC‑MS, NMR, or LC‑DAD).

steps.title: Divide extract into four tubes
steps.instruction: Separate the remaining extract (~40 mL) into four new 13 mL carbonized glass tubes; one tube may be weighed for reference, the other three must contain equal mass of extract.

steps.title: Weigh 10 mg aliquots into microtubes
steps.instruction: From each of the four 13 mL tubes, weigh an aliquot of 10 mg and transfer it into a 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Prepare external QC sample
steps.instruction: Combine the 10 mg aliquots from each tube (dry) into a 50 mL Falcon tube, solubilize the combined material, distribute it into 1.5 mL glass vials, and evaporate each vial to dryness to generate an external QC sample for use across different batches.
